events.description: Monica Geller says Monica Geller could have played Monopoly instead of playing Twister.
Chandler Bing says the incoming phone call is from the Visa card people calling for Rachel Green.
Rachel Green says Chandler Bing will take Rachel Green's place in the Twister game.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing is identifying himself as Rachel Green on the phone call with the Visa card people.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green knows that Rachel Green has not been using the Visa credit card much.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is okay and does not need assistance from the Visa card people.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green has magic beans.
